items.summary: Photonics-based quantum computers open up new possibilities for investigating highly complex problems in mathematics and have the potential to revolutionize fields ranging from energy and chemical research to secure communications. By utilizing the unusual properties of light particles, they can perform calculations that pose enormous challenges even for the most powerful supercomputers—or remain entirely beyond their reach. At Paderborn University, researchers are now investigating a fundamental question using Germany's first scalable photonic quantum computer, a 'Gaussian boson sampler': which quantum resources are most important for the performance of these devices?

Christians are expected to gain 792 million people through natural population change. Instead, the U-M researchers have built a model that considers not only the main fault action but also the activity of rocks that lie adjacent to the fault and become damaged during earthquake events.

items.summary: The US treasury auctioned off $16B of 20-year bonds: High yield 5.459% WI level at the time of the auction 5.459% Tail of 0.0 basis points vs the average of 0.5 basis points Bid to cover of 2.63X vs the average of 2.63X Directs took 26.7% vs the average of 24.3% Indirects took 60.2% vs the average of 63.7% Dealers took 13.1% vs the average of 12.0% Auction grade — C The auction came in right at the when-issued yield, a modest improvement over the average 0.5-basis-point tail. Bid to cover matched the average. Direct bidders took a larger share than usual, but that only partly offset softer indirect demand, leaving dealers with a slightly larger share. The better pricing and mixed demand add up to an average auction. This article was written by Greg Michalowski at investinglive.com.

The latest College Football Playoff rankings will be released on Nov. 17. Here's where Tennessee could land after beating Texas A&M. Tennessee (8-2, 5-2 SEC) beat Texas A&M 22-7 at Kyle Field on Nov. 14 and returns home for its final regular season game at Neyland Stadium this year against No. 23 LSU on Nov. 21 (3:30 p.m. ET, ABC). Even so, a rise doesn't seem to be in store for the Vols — currently ranked No. 9 in the US LBM Coaches Poll and AP Top 25 — when the CFP selection committee releases its newest rankings on Nov. 17 (9 p.m., ESPN). It's even possible they could move down a spot from their current position at No. 8 based on results elsewhere.

Dwyer boys golf returned to its 'mamba mentality' mantra as they secured a Class 3A state championship for the second-straight season. Without both Auburn golfer Hampton Beebe and South Florida golfer Wylie Inman , the Panthers outdid their 2025 roster by three strokes at the Class 3A state championship winning the team's second-straight title with a 584 team score. William Cui paced the entire field with a 139 (5-under) to win the individual crown, guiding a team that made up for its lack in seniority by following the same 'mamba mentality' that head coach Eric Fasone crafted in the wake of basketball legend Kobe Bryant's approach to his game.

Former Washington coach isn't too impressed with the Giants and Cowboys, believes Commanders are a 'realistic threat' to win NFC East. Despite a 1-4 finish in the region, their non-region schedule earned them a bye through the first week, and they made the most of it for a dominant victory over H-K-T. Drought conditions and low reservoir levels are affecting the renewable power source. The US Southwest generated 28% less electricity via hydropower between April and August than the 10-year average, according to new data from the US Energy Information Administration. Most hydropower plants in the US rely on dams to hold back water, creating reservoirs. The water can be released through turbines, generating electricity on demand. But an extreme, prolonged drought in the Colorado River Basin has resulted in dangerously low water levels in the Southwest’s two largest reservoirs, affecting the availability of this power source.

(AP) — USA Swimming will integrate the sport's Paralympic system into its own organization next year as part of an ongoing push in the U. to bring Paralympic sports closer to their roots ahead of the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. Malware cocktail delivers cryptocurrency theft payloads and iOS exploits, among other things. Optimizely serves JavaScript “snippets” that include both company code and code that is provided by each customer. After snow fell across northern England and southern Scotland on Tuesday, is there more on the way? Tiger Woods will return to golf at the Hero World Challenge in the Bahamas next month, his first 72-hole tournament since 2024. The 15-time major champion's last appearance in a PGA Tour event was at the 2024 Open Championship at Royal Troon, where he missed the cut . Prior to that, he completed the 2024 Masters, finishing in 60th place. Woods then missed the entire 2025 season due to a ruptured left Achilles tendon suffered while training for the Masters. The Hero World Challenge is an invitational tournament hosted by Woods himself, featuring a select field of 20 players. The 72-hole event has no cut, and participants are required to walk the course, as carts are not permitted.

Late in Sunday's victory over the Raiders, Seahawks receiver Tory Horton made a heads-up play on special teams that helped seal the win. There was 2:04 remaining in the fourth quarter after Las Vegas narrowed Seattle's lead to one possession with a 43-yard field goal. Former Chicago Tribune sportswriter Fred Mitchell, 78, died Tuesday after a battle with leukemia, his family announced. Mitchell spent more than four decades at the Chicago Tribune, He started at the Tribune in 1974, becoming the first African American sportswriter at the Tribune. At the Tribune, Mitchell served as a beat writer for the Chicago Bulls, Cubs and Bears before becoming a columnist. After retiring from the Tribune, he went on to serve as an adjunct professor at Northwestern University and DePaul University.

Jamal Anderson was the last NFL running back to amass 500+ touches in a season, including the playoffs. That was in 1998. Jahmyr Gibbs could join him. Only four running backs have collected 500+ touches. Emmitt Smith did it twice: 516 in 1992 and then 519 in 1995. Anderson had 517 in 1998. Terrell Davis holds the record with 531 in 1997. Notice that all of this happened within a six-year timeframe... and no one's done it since, even though the league expanded the playoffs and extended the regular season by a game. In fact, no RB has topped 433 touches since DeMarco Murray posted 497 in 2014. Murray regressed sharply the following season. That's usually what happens.

NASCAR's new 2027 Clash format demands four tires and simulated fuel at 200 mph. Teams must master pit road speed limits or face time penalties. Under official supervision, a particular car configuration is required as teams traverse pit road. They cannot just drive a fast lap and go back to the garage. Final times start at the green flag and end at the checkered flag. A driver with the fastest car can still lose the pole if his crew misses a speed limit. Time penalties will be assessed for speeding or other pit stop infractions. It is a bold move that tests execution as much as raw speed.
